prompt: For tomorrow's earnings prep with the CFO, summarize the attached Q3 FY26 segment results deck in six bullets, one per segment, under 120 words in total. Keep every figure exactly as it appears in the deck and don't add commentary on guidance.

I'm building the gross margin bridge for the October close meeting. Using the selected rows of the Margin_Bridge sheet, explain the three biggest drivers of the gross margin change from Q2 to Q3 FY26 in a table (driver, Q2, Q3, change in bps, one-line explanation). Base every explanation on the comments column only; if a driver has no comment, write "no explanation provided" rather than guessing.

Draft the inventory accounting policy note for our FY2026 10-K from the policy memo in this document. Match last year's note style: two paragraphs, past tense, no more than 180 words. Use only the policies the memo states, and list anything the memo leaves unclear as open questions at the end.

Ahead of the disclosure committee meeting, cross-check every share count in the attached draft 10-Q against the equity rollforward on the Shares tab. Return a table with location in the 10-Q, figure stated, rollforward figure and match (yes/no). Don't correct anything; show both values with the page number.

Rewrite the critical audit matter paragraph on goodwill impairment in this document for audit committee members who aren't accountants. Plain English, about 30% shorter than the original. Keep the impairment amount and the discount rate exactly as written, and don't add any conclusion the auditor didn't state.

From the attached lease schedule (Leases_FY26.xlsx), pull every lease with more than five years remaining into a table: lessor, location, commencement date, remaining term, annual payment, sorted by annual payment, largest first. This feeds our ASC 842 maturity disclosure, so give the row number for each lease and leave any blank date blank.

A new staff accountant is drafting our first segment note. Using the ASC 280 guidance in the selected section, explain in under 200 words how we decide which operating segments must be reported separately, with one short worked example of the 10% thresholds. Quote the paragraph number for each rule you rely on.

I'm reviewing the selected revenue recognition memo before it goes to our external auditors. Write eight numbered review questions a senior manager would ask about the performance obligations section, each tied to a specific sentence in the memo. Flag any question where the memo seems to contradict itself.

Our SOX scoping refresh needs a COSO view. For every control listed in the attached Q4_Controls_Inventory.xlsx, name which of the 17 COSO 2013 principles it most directly addresses. Give a table with control ID, control name, principle number and a one-sentence rationale. Where no principle is a clear fit, write "unclear" rather than forcing one.

You are an IT audit senior. Using the change management section of the attached ITGC narrative, write a test procedure checklist for the program change control: no more than 10 steps, each with the evidence to request. Only include steps the narrative supports, and note any step where the narrative is silent.

Before the internal audit committee meets, find the terminated employees in the selected user access review export who still have active accounts. Table: user ID, name, termination date, system, last login. Use only the dates in the export, and say plainly if a system has no termination date column.

Summarize the attached Q3 internal audit report on procurement for the audit committee chair in five bullets: overall rating, number of findings by severity, the highest-risk finding, management's response, and remediation due dates. Keep ratings and dates exactly as written and don't infer anything the report doesn't say.

We're preparing for our first ISO 27001 surveillance audit. Compare the attached Information Security Policy v3 with Annex A control 5.15 on access control and list the gaps in a two-column table: requirement, and what the policy says or "not addressed". Cite the policy section for each row and don't assume a procedure exists if the policy doesn't describe it.

Draft a remediation plan for deficiency D-07 in the attached deficiency tracker for the CAO to review. One page max, with sections for root cause, remediation steps, owner and target date. Use only the facts in the tracker row; where it has no owner or date, write TBD and list those gaps at the end.

For the compliance committee pack, list every policy exception approved in Q3 2026 from the attached exceptions log: exception number, policy, approver, expiry date. Leave out rejected requests. Give the log row for each item and flag any exception with no expiry date.

For a control owner who is new to SOX, explain in plain English and under 150 words what precision means for the management review control in the selected RCM row. Use the threshold stated in that row as the example, and don't describe review steps the row doesn't mention.

For our CDP climate response, extract FY2025 Scope 1 emissions by facility from the Scope 1 tab of the attached GHG_Inventory_2025.xlsx. Table with facility, country, tCO2e and data quality flag, sorted by tCO2e descending. Keep the values exactly as in the file and note any facility whose value is estimated rather than metered.

Our sustainability committee asked why market-based Scope 2 fell from FY2024 to FY2025. Using the selected rows of the Scope 2 summary sheet, identify the sites behind most of the decrease and show them in a table (site, FY2024, FY2025, change, share of total change). Phrase any reasons as possibilities drawn from the notes column, not as facts.

Draft the water management section of our FY2025 sustainability report from the attached site water data. The readers are investors, so keep it to three short paragraphs under 250 words and include total withdrawal and the year-over-year change. Use only figures from the file and mark any number you calculated yourself.

This is for our CSRD readiness review. Map each datapoint in the attached ESRS_E1_datapoints.xlsx to whether our FY2025 climate disclosure draft, also attached, covers it. Table: datapoint ID, short name, covered (yes/partial/no), page reference in the draft. Don't mark a datapoint as covered unless you can point to the text.

We go into limited assurance next month. In the attached FY2025 fleet fuel log, find any month where a vehicle used more than double its own monthly average, and any repeated receipt numbers. List them in a table with vehicle, month, litres and why it was flagged. Don't estimate corrected values.
For procurement leadership: summarize the selected supplier audit findings table in five bullets, with counts exactly as shown, and say if any supplier has no risk rating.

Our board's sustainability committee wants a primer before we adopt IFRS S2. Using the attached IFRS S2 standard, explain what it requires a company to disclose about a climate transition plan, in no more than 200 words, ending with three bullets on what would be new for a first-time preparer. Cite the paragraph for each requirement.

Before the sustainability report goes to our assurance provider, check that every emissions figure in the attached report draft matches the GHG inventory workbook, also attached. Return a table: report page, figure in the report, workbook figure, match. List mismatches first and don't decide which value is right.

Rewrite the selected paragraph of my project status update for the steering committee: under 100 words, leading with the decision we need from them. Keep the dates and budget figures exactly as written and don't add risks that aren't in the original.

In the Expenses sheet of the attached Budget_Tracker.xlsx, I need a formula for column H that returns "Over" when actual spend in column F is more than 10% above budget in column E, otherwise "OK". Our department heads will copy it down 400 rows. Give the formula with a one-line explanation, and tell me if blank cells in column E would break it.

Draft a 150-word email to the regional finance leads announcing the November close calendar in the attached Close_Calendar_Nov2026.docx. Friendly but direct, with the three key deadlines as bullets. Copy the dates exactly from the document and don't mention anything the calendar doesn't include.

I'm interviewing our AP team lead next week as part of a process walkthrough. Based on the attached AP process narrative, write ten interview questions grouped under invoice receipt, approval and payment. Point each question to a step in the narrative and mark any step the narrative describes only vaguely.

From the meeting minutes in this document, list every action item for the finance transformation workstream in a table (owner, action, due date) sorted by due date. It's going into the PMO tracker, so use the minutes' own wording for each action and write "no date given" where the minutes don't set one.

Compare the two attached vendor proposals (Proposal_A.pdf and Proposal_B.pdf) for our procurement committee on price, implementation timeline and support terms. One table with a row per criterion and a one-sentence takeaway for each. Use only what the proposals state and flag where either one is silent on a criterion.
